physics_goals.quote: aims to measure the coherent elastic neutrino-nucleus scattering process from antineutrinos emitted by a research nuclear reactor
physics_goals.value: Measure CEvNS from reactor antineutrinos using multiple target materials (Ge, Zn) to probe the Standard Model prediction and search for new physics

summary.plain: A reactor-neutrino experiment at a French research reactor, using ultra-cold germanium and zinc crystals just a few metres from the reactor core to catch antineutrinos bouncing off whole atomic nuclei.
summary.technical: Ricochet: reactor CEvNS experiment at the ILL research reactor (Grenoble, France), 8.8 m from the 58 MW reactor core, using a planned kg-scale CryoCube array of Ge and Zn cryogenic calorimeters; a 126 g (3 x 42 g Ge) mini-CryoCube commissioning module was operated and characterized in 2025.
